messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: High error rate on serving cluster us-west-2 — suspected GPU OOM during prefill. Triggered by long-context requests. Runbook: <https://redwood/runbooks/prefill-oom|prefill-oom>

oncall-jay: taking ownership, paging SRE. I'll start triage.

anna-sre: ping — can you paste the failing container id / node? any core dumps?

oncall-jay: node=node-77, pod=redwood-runtime-77b4, container=runtime-gpu. Grabbed logs: ```2026-02-18T04:12:33Z runtime ERROR: CUDA out of memory when allocating 6.2 GiB at prefill step
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/serve/prefill.py", line 142, in allocate_prefill
    kv_cache = torch.empty((seq, emb), device='cuda')
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.
Container restarted by kubelet at 04:12:34Z
```

sam-eng: looks like very large prefix tokens — customer's session sent ~120k tokens in a single request. Recommend immediate mitigations: 1) enable prefill_token_limit (2048) on that route, 2) enable aggressive kvcache eviction for node-77, 3) route new prefills to fallback CPU-safe model.

maria-ops: CSMs — any customer impact? which tenants hit this?

zoe-cs: verified: 3 production tenants had streaming failures (acct: acme-pay, orbit-ads, homeflow). Acme-pay hit live checkout errors, now opened priority-1 ticket.

anna-sre: executing live mitigations now: `kubectl cordon node-77 && kubectl drain node-77 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` to stop new pods landing, and `kubectl scale deployment redwood-runtime --replicas=0 --namespace=prod --selector=zone=us-west-2` for hotpool switch (temporary). Also flipping routing flag: `route.prefill_policy=prefer-fallback-small`.

oncall-jay: applied route flags and prefill_token_limit=2048 for the affected customer routes. Throttle added: 10 concurrent prefill requests per org.

deploy-bot: NOTE: Scaling action recorded — deployment/redwood-runtime replicas 5 -> 2 at 04:16:12Z by oncall-jay.

maria-ops: drafting customer comms: "We saw transient errors affecting long inputs, we throttled large prefill requests and routed to a fallback model to restore service. Our team is actively investigating root cause and will share timeline." Approving now.

anna-sre: for follow-up: snapshot of pod mem metrics + nvlink usage, full coredump if present. Please collect `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,UTILIZATION` and `kubectl logs -p` for the restarted container.

sam-eng: logging note: add guard to prefill path to reject >50k tokens with 413 and return helpful message. I'll open a small patch.

oncall-jay: confirmed impact window ~04:11:58Z - 04:18:40Z. Fallback routing restored streams by 04:15Z for most customers, full restoration by 04:19Z. No data exfiltration suspected.

zoe-cs: Acme-pay support notified, they accepted temporary mitigation and want timeline.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Severity -> Sev2, Pager rotation maintained. Triage channel created: #incident-4632105555. Postmortem requested, assign to ENG-RT and SRE.

anna-sre: leaving for on-call handoff in 15m — documenting actions in the incident doc. Oncall-jay will take post-restore checks.

oncall-jay: will run the follow-ups: collect metrics, reopen if any restart loops. Good coordination, thanks all :thumbsup:
